_comment: VALIDATION-ONLY MORAI scenario for the Highway Merge Ego-on-Ramp Scenario v1. NOT a production scenario and NOT a default. Loaded only via an explicit `ad_morai_scenario_reset scenario_file:=...` / `ad_morai_scenario_setup` invocation or the opt-in ad_planner highway_merge_ego_ramp_scenario.launch.py. The production competition route ad_data/path/2026_molit_comp_global_path.txt is unchanged.

vehicleList._role: front mainline vehicle on route:0 (route_s ~ 1200 m)
